_source: Remaster data for a Phantasie III import from the C64 copy alone (profiles p3-c64, p3-c64-1.2), applied by the importer (OpenPhantasie.Importer.Pipelines.P3C64.P3C64Tables.Write) to the GameData P3C64Tables builds: DOS III's value in every number / structure cell where the C64's differs or it has none (the rule of the Apple and Amiga III imports: the reference version's numbers), so III plays the same whichever version was imported. The C64's own text is kept. Made by tools/scripts/build_c64_p3_import.py from the importer's raw build; the groups: reverse-engineering/c64/phantasie3/FORMAT.md sections 3 and 7.
_dos_cells: As phantasie3/apple2-import.json (CellPatches): a path into the GameData file the C64 import builds; a string is an object key, a number an array index; 'byte' = an offset into a hex string. A cell holding the C64 value takes the DOS value; one holding neither is kept and warned. Whole arrays or objects where the shapes differ; map rows whole.

dos.name: Many men guard a tent here

dos_cells.why: terrain of a tile: not read on the C64

dos._note: terrain index t: name = master string 54 + t; the first matching range wins; any other tile = 4 (no name). Netherworld overrides first. Tiles >= 242 are blocked (River Styx; 'Ocean' on Scandor). No random encounters on t 10 (Water), 8 (Lava), 15 (Styx); Water swims, Lava hurts (damage size [?]).

dos_cells.why: dungeon records

dos.8-17: random-encounter square: fight when FAR:0xdd8c > rand() % 100, monster 12L + (cell - 8) + rand() % 3 (ovl4 0xeb5)
dos.0xb9 / 0xc8: doors; 0xba-0xc6 / 0xc9-0xd5 doors with monsters behind (monster cell - 186 / cell - 201, plus 12L)
